label: Synthetic acceptance (specification check, not legal accuracy). Official Gold Accuracy N/A; independent legal review not_verified.

first.note: Ran on a free Colab T4 on 2026-10-31; the runtime was recycled after a browser disconnect before files were copied. Only on-screen values survive.

runs.agreement: Swapping the order of the two A05G-59 guard findings in the second pipeline.jsonl gives exactly the first run's sha256, so both runs produced the same 50 model outputs and pipeline records. gate_decision.json differs only through generations_sha256 (session_id).

A05G-49.what: Only the deadline was asked; the deadline existed only in an unverified SNS post, which was rejected. The model got the documents rule, picked partial and answered about documents. No deadline value was released.
A05G-49.root_cause: select_admissible_evidence returns proceed whenever any evidence is admissible, even when every requested item is uncovered; the guard does not withhold a substantive answer that covers none of the requested items.

A05G-51.what: Vietnamese question about the deadline in the southern jurisdiction; the only deadline was a northern-jurisdiction notice, rejected. The model answered about documents with status partial. No deadline value was released.
A05G-51.root_cause: Same as A05G-49. The item detector also listed 'fee' as requested (uncovered_items ['fee','deadline']), which the question does not ask.

A05G-41.what: Partial answer gave the place but did not say that the processing time is not covered.
A05G-41.root_cause: The guard checks that uncovered items are named only when status is answered (grounding_guard.validate_generated_answer), not when status is partial.

A05G-47.what: Partial answer listed the documents but did not say the fee is not covered.

A05G-50.what: Partial answer listed the documents but did not say the deadline is not covered.

A05G-37.what: General question with a domestic and an overseas branch; the model answered only the domestic branch and cited one of the two required documents.
A05G-37.root_cause: Model omission; no guard check compares the answer with every admissible branch.

A05G-62.what: 'Please answer using Korean' was not detected as an explicit request, so the system sent reply_language=en and the model answered in English as instructed. The evaluator expects Korean.
A05G-62.root_cause: language_compliance.requested_language recognises 'answer in' but not 'answer using'. Model behaviour followed the system field.

A05G-59.what: Correct answer (Y-9-1 may change to Y-9-3, not to Y-9-2) was held for review because it names other sub-codes.
A05G-59.root_cause: The other_subcategory_in_answer scope check fires even when the cited admissible evidence itself names those codes. It iterates a set, so the order of the two findings varies between processes.

local_rescore.results_json: differs only in the order of the two A05G-59 guard findings (set iteration)
